response.sql:
WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS behavior_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx
    ON ab.translink = tx.transreg
  JOIN trader AS tr
    ON tx.trdref = tr.tradereg
  GROUP BY tr.tradekind
), shares AS (
  SELECT tradekind,
         behavior_count,
         CAST(behavior_count AS REAL) / SUM(behavior_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM type_counts
), averages AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT tradekind,
       behavior_count,
       share,
       share - average_share AS excess_share
FROM averages
WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL
  AND share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: SQLite groups NULL tradekind values together, treating the missing trader type as its own group; the plain average is the unweighted arithmetic mean of the per-type shares.
